name: Vows of Vana'diel
about: The launcher as a Vana'diel wedding: an invitation in ivory card and burgundy satin with gold foil and a lace edge, wax seals pressed with wedding emblems (PLAY's carries two interlocking gold rings), rose petals when a button is lit. Banners are a wedding album: the invitation, the three palaces (Chateau d'Oraguille, the Metalworks, Heavens Tower), the vows, the fireworks and a marriage certificate, framing the official 2009 wedding-site pictures (Hurami's ffxwedding folder, copied to art-src\wedding). Drawn in code by art-src\scripts\vows_lib.py, vows_buttons.py and vows_banners.py (started from Hurami's 'Vows of Vana'diel' preview). Lettering inside the pictures: Cormorant SC and Great Vibes (SIL OFL). Its song is 'Eternal Vows' by Hurami (vows_eternal_vows.mp3). "standard": true makes it what players wear when nothing is picked on the Theme page (the user, 2026-11-27; Windurst before that). "takeover" clears every PC's earlier pick once, so everyone wears it after the update that brings it (launcher_theme.takeover).
